title: 3 Days in Tokyo - Perfect City Itinerary
author: Tiago Ferreira
excerpt: Make the most of your Tokyo visit with this complete 3-day itinerary covering all must-see attractions.
content:
Day 1: East Tokyo

Morning: Visit Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa

Afternoon: Explore the vintage shops of Harajuku and Takeshita Street

Day 2: South Tokyo

Morning: Enjoy Shibuya Crossing and shopping

Evening: Sunset from Tokyo Tower

Day 3: West Tokyo & Nature

Morning: Meiji Shrine forest walk

Afternoon: Shinjuku gardens and district exploration
